sources.running_openapi: GET /openapi.json of the provisioned guest's outer Agent Server (docker runtime, not selectable): 131 paths, 170 operations
sources.binary: the release binary of the provision lock (release_binary, sha256 b2fbcf8cf1495bdbef97f26583917bc188b765c71c181effc3e47c14da08ce72), its PyInstaller archive read as data: openhands/agent_server/api.py _add_api_routes and every router module; never run on the host
sources.not_available: the locked wheel and the release openapi.json were not read for this leaf (no network); the release document describes the local runtime only (evidence F-04.2 finding 1)

admission.rule: every route but the public set needs a credential: the session key (header, or for /v1/* also a bearer token), the init key (POST /api/init), the workspace cookie the key mints, an app session the key mints, or first-message WebSocket auth with the key
admission.unsecured_if_empty: Config.session_api_keys: "Empty list implies the server will be unsecured" (1.60.1); empty values are dropped. The unit's ExecStartPre refuses to start without a valid key.

classes.public-read: no credential; server metadata, health and documentation, read only
classes.management-read: key-gated GET of conversation, event, runtime or tool-catalogue state
classes.privileged: key-gated (or another credential the key mints): creates, controls or deletes conversations, runtimes, agents or extensions; executes commands; reads or writes files, git state, secrets, credentials, settings, profiles, skills, plugins, LLM or MCP configuration; mints sessions

dispatcher_values.allowed: the trusted dispatcher may call it (the F-04.2 lifecycle, inspection reads, the public metadata)
dispatcher_values.validation: used only by the admission probe in a disposable conversation
dispatcher_values.not-used: the key would admit it, but the dispatcher never calls it; the Agent Server cannot scope its key per route, so this is the dispatcher's allowlist (E-01.2.x), not a server control

routes.note: init status; 404 unless the server runs with deferred_init, which the profile forbids
